# Vision For Xperiences (vfx.productions)

> Multidisciplinary creative studio in the Netherlands. VFX, 3D animation,
> live and festival visuals, interactive art installations, and licensed drone
> cinematography, delivered by one team from previz through final delivery.

Contact: studio@vfx.productions (briefs answered within 48 hours).
Budget bands: under EUR 1,000 / EUR 1,000-5,000 / EUR 5,000-15,000 / EUR 15,000+.
Takes on work at budget levels most full-service houses decline.

## Services
- [VFX](/vfx): compositing, set extensions, tracking, simulations, stylised looks
- [3D Animation](/animation): product visuals, cinematic shorts, motion systems, stage worlds
- [Live Visuals](/visuals): festival screens, DJ and artist visuals, reactive show content
- [Interactive Design](/technology): art installations, educational devices, real-time experiences
- [Drone Operator](/droneoperator): licensed UAV, aerial cinematics, event and location coverage
- [Shop](/shop): presets, packs, motion templates, 3D asset bundles
